correctness.rationale: Finite Alexandrov continuity is monotonicity, openness is equality of principal upset images. For q>=2 a lower-to-upper image forces a constant upper map; otherwise upper mapping is permutation and lower arbitrary. For q=1 every point may map to the top or another lower, with top fixed. Explicit compositions prove monoid structure. Symbolic proof handles all p,q>=1. Exhaustive selfmap tests for nine p,q pairs independently returned CHECK_OK.
